title: SPY Weekly Report — Week of Oct 19–23, 2026
html:
Links: SPY · Watchlist · Options Playbook · Fed Tracker · Federal Reserve · Levels: 2026-10-23 Levels · Prior: 2026-10-16 SPY Weekly Report · Claude Doc:

1. Bottom line and house view

SPY closed at $759.97 (−0.43% on the week), right at the 61.8% retracement ($760.68) of the Sep 16 → Oct 6 rally. It's a second losing week, and SPY is still above its 200-day ($724). SPX 7,623.68. Thursday's AI and tech sell-off (Nasdaq −2.6%, Meta −7%) and oil (WTI ~$103, Brent $116.72) drove the week; the 10-yr is ~5.0%. October Fed hike odds fell to ~5%.

Earnings: TSLA adj. EPS $0.48 beat, operating income −56%, capex guide cut to ~$20B; stock +4.9% on the week. BE −11% Friday on negative cash flow despite a beat. SPCX beat (+1.9%). NOW +12% ahead of its Oct 28 report.
